subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & US/EU residency impact
messages:
From: Amit Sharma <amit@fintechco.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-20 09:12 -0700
Subject: Follow-up on yesterday's call — pricing and residency questions

Thanks for the call yesterday, Dylan — Lina and I had a few follow-ups as we carve up the budget for H2. High level: we liked Redwood's performance, but need clearer unit economics to model cost across our US and EU workloads.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm expected $/1M tokens for hosted API in US and in EU (if different)?
- If we seed with 10M tokens/day steady state (spiky to 25M/day), what monthly cost range should we expect?
- Are there incremental charges or markup for EU data residency?
- Any discounts/committing guidance to reach ~ $X / 1M tokens target (we're thinking $60-$75 per 1M tokens target)

Also, compliance: we need confirmation that EU data can be pinned to EU region and whether that affects price.

Appreciate a short recap and next steps.

— Amit
Amit Sharma
Head of Platform Engineering, FintechCo

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Amit Sharma <amit@fintechco.com>, Lina Torres <lina@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-20 11:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up on yesterday's call — pricing and residency questions

Amit — thanks for the clear list. Recap + answers below. I kept this high level; forwarding to Marissa/SEs for exact numbers and an attached estimate.

Recap / answers:
- Baseline hosted API unit economics (US region): our on-demand retail is typically around $90 / 1M tokens for the model class we demoed. With committed volume (reserved monthly commit), you should expect to reach the $60–$75 / 1M tokens band you mentioned depending on term and total committed tokens.
- EU region: expect ~10–20% higher unit cost versus US on hosted API. Primary drivers: cross-region infra premium, added operational overhead for data residency, and regional replication for audit trails. Exact uplift depends on whether you need EU-only storage/ingress and dedicated regional caching.
- 10M tokens/day steady (300M/month) — very rough hosted estimate: $27k–$45k/month in US list prices; with a committed discount could be ~$18k–$22.5k/month (hits the $60–$75 / 1M tokens target). For EU-resident workloads, add ~10–20% on top of those numbers.
- Spiky peaks to 25M/day — we recommend an autoscale/burst plan to avoid overcommitting; peak capacity cost is typically smoothed by our burst credits and can be accounted for in a capped monthly commitment.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm expected monthly token profile (steady vs peak days, % EU traffic).
2) I'll loop in Marissa + Sean to produce a 1-page committed pricing estimate (tiered view) and an attachment with a short commitment term model.
3) If you need EU-only data residency SLAs, we'll flag Dedicated/Private options (pricing differs materially) — we can provide that comparison in the estimate.

Note: attaching a working estimate (will send updated from pricing team).

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-20 11:07 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up on yesterday's call — FintechCo pricing/residency (DEAL-8721)

Marissa / Sean — looped for committed pricing and EU uplift guidance. Key ask from FintechCo: target $60–$75 / 1M tokens if possible for mixed US/EU workloads. They expect ~10M tokens/day steady (300M/mo) with spikes to 25M/day. They will also require EU data residency for EU users (approx 40% of traffic).

Please see my quick calc above — can you:
- Confirm committed tier pricing that hits $60–$75 / 1M at 300M/mo and what term/commitment needed.
- Provide an explicit EU uplift percent to include in the estimate (list vs committed).
- Flag whether Dedicated/Private is recommended for strict residency and a high-level monthly delta.

I've started a working sheet (link below). Would like to send them a one-page estimate by EOD tomorrow.

DL

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-21 09:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up on yesterday's call — FintechCo pricing/residency (DEAL-8721)

Dylan / Sean — see attached pricing_estimate_v2.xlsx (uploaded to Drive). Summary below:

Assumptions:
- Model class: LLM-A (same used in demo); token mix mostly generation (~85%) with ~15% embedding calls.
- Monthly steady tokens: 300M (10M/day). Peak daily up to 25M (handled with burst).
- EU traffic: 40% of tokens need EU residency.

Committed pricing (monthly commit, 12-month term) — blended view:
- US-hosted committed: $62 / 1M tokens (with 12mo commit at 300M/mo)
- EU-hosted committed uplift: +15% => $71.3 / 1M tokens (EU-only storage + regional infra costs)
- Blended (60% US / 40% EU): $65.5 / 1M tokens approx.

Monthly cost estimate (committed blended):
- 300M tokens/month x $65.5 / 1M = $19,650 / month (~$235,800 / year)
- With spikes to 25M/day, recommend 10% burst buffer in commitment pricing or a small overage cap; estimated monthly delta +$2k–$4k depending on burst frequency.

Notes on Dedicated/Private:
- For strict residency + SOC2 + on-prem logs, Dedicated adds a material uplift (approx +40–70% on top of hosted committed, primarily infra and managed capacity). Recommend hosted committed first; if FintechCo requires contractually enforced EU-only processing and longer retention, we should model Dedicated in a separate comparison.

I'll prepare a one-page summary for Dylan to send. If you want aggressive pricing to hit sub-$60 / 1M, we need a larger multi-year or higher monthly commit (500M+/mo) — I can model that if they indicate appetite.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Pricing & Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Amit Sharma <amit@fintechco.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-03-22 16:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & next steps

Thanks — this is helpful. Blended $65.5 / 1M and the committed numbers are in line with expectations. A few quick items:
- Please include the EU uplift callout on the one-pager (we need to show procurement).
- Can you mark the SOC2/Dedicated delta clearly — procurement will want both hosted committed and dedicated comparatives.
- We can provisionally commit to a 12mo 300M/mo if final legal terms look standard — want to see a draft SOW + pricing attachment.

Next step: send the one-pager and the Drive link to procurement; Lina will own legal. If pricing and residency language looks good we can lock in the pilot by end of the month.

— Amit
